purpose: Select the lowest-dose checkpoint that demonstrates the intended recommendation ordering correction without action drift. This gate is not an online score estimator.
selection_rule: Evaluate step 200, 400, and 600 with the same deterministic script and locked manifest. Select the earliest checkpoint meeting every hard candidate requirement. Run the itemic structure precheck on the provisional earliest candidate; if it fails, continue to the next dose. If none passes, reject I-16 locally. Do not use synthetic world accuracy or action repetition to rank checkpoints.
anti_overclaim: The holdout informed mechanism selection and is not an unbiased competition validation set. Passing this gate supports only mechanism execution and disaster safety, not an expected online score or guaranteed gain.
